name: MessageGears
description: MessageGears Cloud provides transactional messaging, rendering, and aggregate delivery reporting through account-bound web services.
agentUseSummary: Connect the exact customer-owned account ID and API key. Relay pins five POST-only 3.1 actions: one aggregate account read runs directly, two exact job/preview reads and two one-recipient transactional sends require approval, and sends additionally require recorded recipient authorization.

credentialRequirements.name: MESSAGEGEARS_ACCOUNT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: MessageGears account ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the exact customer-owned MessageGears Cloud account ID.

credentialRequirements.name: MESSAGEGEARS_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: MessageGears API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned API key for the exact account.

capabilities.label: Read account summary
capabilities.description: Use one aggregate daily account summary read.

capabilities.label: Read job or preview data
capabilities.description: Use one exact bulk-job summary and one bounded one-recipient message preview with approval.

capabilities.label: Send transactional messages
capabilities.description: Use two one-recipient transactional sends with approval and recipient authorization attestation.

allowed.label: Read MessageGears account summary
allowed.description: Read one aggregate daily account summary from the fixed Cloud web service.

approvalRequired.label: Read MessageGears job or preview data
approvalRequired.description: Read an exact bulk-job aggregate or render a bounded one-recipient preview.

approvalRequired.label: Send MessageGears transactional messages
approvalRequired.description: Send one authorized recipient a direct-template or promoted-campaign transactional message.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Account IDs, API keys, authorization parameters, and credential-bearing response elements never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Run bulk or streaming APIs
blocked.description: Bulk sends, daily activity file streams, SQS/event feeds, recipient-list URLs, imports, exports, and unbounded transfers are excluded.

blocked.label: Administer accounts or attach content
blocked.description: Account administration, key rotation, attachments, thumbnails, forwarding, custom headers/tracking domains, and delivery infrastructure remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only five pinned actions run via POST form data on the fixed 3.1 Cloud web service; arbitrary actions, URLs, headers, XML entities, and oversized requests are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The aggregate account summary runs directly; exact job/preview reads and both one-recipient sends require approval, and sends also require explicit recipient authorization attestation.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All five selected operations run without Relay per-action approval; recipient authorization, fixed routing, allowlists, bounds, audits, and bulk/admin/attachment blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts five pinned MessageGears actions and injects encrypted account credentials only into fixed POST forms.

providerSetup.blocker: MessageGears requires a customer-owned account, API key, configured sending identity/infrastructure, and promoted campaign for campaign-based sends. No console, account, key, sender, campaign, recipient consent, message, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure a dedicated staging account/key in Railway staging, complete sender/domain and optional promoted-campaign setup outside this worker, and verify account/job reads, preview, approval and recipient-authorization denial/allow, one-recipient sends, XML/form bounds, rate behavior, key rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: MessageGears documents the fixed 3.1 WebService URL, POST recommendation, 2 MB provider request ceiling, XML responses, available actions, and common success/error format.
MessageGears documents exact bulk-job summary identifiers and aggregate delivery, engagement, unsubscribe, complaint, and render-error results.
MessageGears documents the one-recipient transactional job action, required account/key/form fields, templates, and optional capabilities excluded by Relay.
MessageGears documents well-formed Recipient XML, a Recipient root, one required EmailAddress, and the sensitivity of recipient identifiers.
